snr_definition_declared: Per complex received OFDM symbol entry before processing: E|a X|^2/E|noise|^2; unit QPSK; received amplitude 10^(SNR/20), complex noise variance 1; each BS same controlled received SNR (configs/symbol_frontend.json:57)

path.fact: snr_db=[5,10,15,20], nominal 20; per-entry received-SNR definition; same scalar for all three BS
snr loop outside the batch loop; snr_db passed unchanged to synthesize_batch for every target and station
noise = (randn + j randn)/sqrt(2) per received entry, E|n|^2=1; drawn per target from the target seed
Y = clean + noise for each batch element (one target); there is no target-dimension summation and no shared receiver noise
B = Y / X removes the unit-modulus modulation; noise variance unchanged
no detector in the path; detected[frame,slot]=True is assigned for every oracle-present target
coarse range/Doppler FFT (288), rough localization from measured ranges (296-301), bounded Gauss-Newton, then grid search with steps 0.25 m/0.25 m/s and fine 0.025 (302-311)

noise_added_to: per-target isolated echo (batch element), before any target combination

integration_gain.mechanism: coherent 2D FFT (256 range x 256 Doppler) plus steering maximization; no explicit post-integration SNR is computed by the code

search_quantization.interpretation: cache-level max |estimate-truth| is one fine search cell; error is lattice-dominated, not noise-dominated

paired_across_snr.seed_recipe: SHA256(ASCII 2026:episode:frame:slot:101) first 8 bytes little-endian & 2^63-1; independent of SNR
paired_across_snr.measured_identical_noise: max spread of per-target noise_rms across -20..20 dB = 2.22e-16
paired_across_snr.consequence: SNR reruns are paired; only signal amplitude changes

why_official_range_is_flat: no detection threshold exists: detected is an oracle presence assignment (generate_symbol_gpu.py:52)
each target is estimated from its own isolated echo with its own noise; there is no multi-target noise-limited competition
the 256x256 coherent transform supplies about 48 dB processing gain, so 5 dB per-entry SNR becomes roughly 53 dB effective at the range-Doppler peak
the estimator error is bounded by one fine search step (0.025 m / 0.025 m/s); measured max errors 0.022-0.032 m and 0.023-0.027 m/s in the official range
the same noise realization is reused across SNR (paired seeds), so only the deterministic amplitude changes
